short_description: Munich-headquartered German mobility technology company (founded 2019 by Max-Josef Meier, Maximilian Wuhr, Nikolai Schroder, Andreas Stryz, Max Beyer and Hans-Peter Ringer) that operates an all-inclusive multi-brand car subscription marketplace in Germany and the United States; reached unicorn status in 2026 following a EUR 140M Series D that valued the company at approximately EUR 1B.
